correctness.rationale: The shifted field fixes (u,v)=(0,0) throughout the admissible unfolding; its Jacobian has trace 2μ and determinant BD−1−2μ. The eigenvalues are complex near μ=0 and the real part crosses with speed one. Independent polar return-map algebra gives L=average(C_r−Q_r Q_θ/ω): the quadratic radial term averages to zero, so its iterated contribution to the cubic return coefficient vanishes. Exact angular moments give the stated −D[B(D+2)−3]/[8B(BD−1)]. The nondegenerate Hopf theorem yields locally unique attracting or repelling cycles on μL<0, with the stated leading radius and period. The condition D>1 is necessary for the subcritical regime under BD>1; the examples give −1/4 and 5/16 at the same frequency. Small cycles remain near (1,1), so they are strictly positive and lie in y>1/2. No Bautin claim is justified or made on L=0.
residual_risks: Purely local deterministic theorem for the displayed parameter family; no higher-order or global cycle classification or empirical inference.
